title: Qt: Fix transient parent of filter button pop-up
description:
When the filter button is located in a submenu, the QMenu
that is the object whose QCustomMenuEvent is filtered ought
to be the parent of the pop-up. Prevents console warnings:

 ** (wireshark:82172) 20:49:55.750517 [GUI WARNING] -- Creating a popup with a parent, QWidgetWindow(0x7c4e0c84e7a0, name="WiresharkMainWindowWindow") which does not match the current topmost grabbing popup, QWidgetWindow(0x7c4e0c75f5a0, name="QMenuClassWindow") With some shell surface protocols, this is not allowed. The wayland QPA plugin is currently handling it by setting the parent to the topmost grabbing popup. Note, however, that this may cause positioning errors and popups closing unxpectedly. Please fix the transient parent of the popup.


(cherry picked from commit cfd32882d45a9a0631b546d69a7c8a7ed6390d69)

Co-authored-by: John Thacker <johnthacker@gmail.com>
